Context/Background:
Sonic hedgehog medulloblastoma (SHH-MB), characterized by hyperactivation of the namesake Sonic hedgehog (SHH) signaling pathway, accounts for ∼30% of all medulloblastoma (MB) and occurs across all age groups. Cerebellar granule neuron progenitors (GNPs) are the developmental origin of SHH-MB. Germline loss-of-function (LOF) variants in Elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 1 (ELP1) are the most prevalent predisposing genetic events in childhood MB, accounting for ∼30% of the SHH 3 subtype. The mechanism(s) by which germline ELP1 deficiency provokes SHH-MB pathogenesis remain unknown. To resolve the mechanistic basis of ELP1-associated SHH-MB, we generated a germline Elp1+/− mouse model using CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing (designated as Elp1HET mice).

We analyzed multi-omic signatures in GNPs collected from P7 Elp1HET mice compared to littermate controls. ELP1 was the only differentially expressed gene by bulk RNA-seq. Given ELP1’s crucial role in stabilizing the Elongator complex (essential for efficient translation), we performed TMT-MS and polysome profiling on isolates from P7 Elp1HET and Elp1WT GNPs.
Prompt: Based on the study context, summarize most relevant pathways and leading edge genes from the GSEA results of the differential analysis between Elp1HET and Elp1WT GNPs in both TMT-MS and polysome profiling.
output_text:
Introduction/Context  
Mouse P7 cerebellar granule neuron progenitors (GNPs) with germline Elp1 haploinsufficiency (Elp1HET) versus wild-type (Elp1WT) were profiled by tandem-mass-tag proteomics (TMT-MS) and polysome profiling. Bulk RNA-seq showed only Elp1 itself as DE, motivating interrogation of downstream translational and proteomic changes. GSEA was performed on: 1) TMT-MS log₂ fold-changes (Elp1HET/WT) across ~7,900 proteins and 2) polysome-associated translation efficiencies (Table S2).  

Keywords  
• Translation/ribosome • tRNA aminoacylation • Amino acid metabolism • Mitochondrial bioenergetics • Chromatin organization  

Candidate Genes  
RPL18A, RPS27A, RPS6, RPS13, RPS9, LARS2, YARS, PLK1  

Pathway Enrichments  

1. Polysome Profiling GSEA (preranked NES)  
Counts by library (UP vs DOWN):  
• KEGG_2016: 1 UP, 1 DOWN (100%/100%)  
• GO_Biological_Process_2023: 18 UP, 0 DOWN (100%/–)  
• Reactome_Pathways_2024: 0 UP, 5 DOWN (–/100%)  
• MSigDB_Hallmark_2020: 1 UP, 0 DOWN (100%/–)  

KEGG_2016 (UP):  
| Theme                               | Direction | Leading Genes                                |  
|-------------------------------------|-----------|-----------------------------------------------|  
| Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis         | Up        | Lars2, Yars, Mars2, Mars1, Cars, Dars, … Eprs |

KEGG_2016 (DOWN):  
| Theme   | Direction | Leading Genes                             |  
|---------|-----------|--------------------------------------------|  
| Ribosome| Down      | Rps3a1, Rps16, Rpsa, Rpl9, Mrpl13, … Rps21 |

GO_Biological_Process_2023 (UP):  
| Theme                            | Direction | Leading Genes                       |  
|----------------------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------|  
| Sister chromatid segregation     | Up        | Smc3, Cenpe, Nusap1, Plk1, … Top2a   |

GO_Biological_Process_2023 (DOWN):  
| Theme                   | Direction | Leading Genes                        |  
|-------------------------|-----------|---------------------------------------|  
| Cytoplasmic translation | Down      | Rpl18a, Rpl26, Rpl7a, Rps13, … Rpl8   |

Reactome_Pathways_2024 (UP):  
| Theme                          | Direction | Leading Genes                           |  
|--------------------------------|-----------|------------------------------------------|  
| tRNA aminoacylation            | Up        | Lars2, Yars, Mars2, Mars1, Cars, Dars, …|

Reactome_Pathways_2024 (DOWN):  
| Theme                                                     | Direction | Leading Genes                         |  
|-----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|----------------------------------------|  
| SRP-dependent Cotranslational Protein Targeting to Membrane | Down      | Srp9, Rps3a1, Rps16, Spcs1, … Rps21   |

MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 (UP):  
| Theme            | Direction | Leading Genes                                    |  
|------------------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------|  
| Mitotic spindle  | Up        | Plk1, Cdk5rap2, NuMa1, Espl1, … Kif23             |

MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 (DOWN):  
| Theme | Direction | Leading Genes |  
|-------|-----------|---------------|  
| –     | –         | –             |  

Together, polysome profiling shows suppression of core translational machineries (ribosome, SRP targeting, elongation/initiation) and activation of cell-cycle/chromatin programs (mitotic spindle, sister chromatid segregation), suggesting Elp1 deficiency impairs mRNA translation but triggers compensatory proliferative signaling.

2. TMT-MS Proteomics GSEA  
Counts by library:  
• KEGG_2016: 6 up, 5 down (55%/45%)  
• GO_Biological_Process_2023: 5 up, 5 down (50%/50%)  
• Reactome_Pathways_2024: 5 up, 5 down (50%/50%)  
• MSigDB_Hallmark_2020: 3 up, 2 down (60%/40%)  

KEGG_2016 (UP):  
| Theme                   | Direction | Leading Genes                                   |  
|-------------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|  
| Parkinson's disease     | Up        | Ndufb4, Cox4i1, Ndufb11, Cox7c, Sdhc, … Ndufb7  |  
| Peroxisome              | Up        | Pex26, Slc25a17, Abcd3, Pecr, Far1, Pex3         |

KEGG_2016 (DOWN):  
| Theme      | Direction | Leading Genes                                |  
|------------|-----------|-----------------------------------------------|  
| Ribosome   | Down      | Mrpl33, Rpl18a, Rpl26, Rpl7a, Rps13, Rps27a, … |

GO_Biological_Process_2023 (UP):  
| Theme                 | Direction | Leading Genes                                          |  
|-----------------------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------|  
| Mitochondrion organization | Up  | Nos3, Pnpt1, Timm44, MfN1, Dnaja3, Tomm70, …           |

GO_Biological_Process_2023 (DOWN):  
| Theme                    | Direction | Leading Genes                              |  
|--------------------------|-----------|---------------------------------------------|  
| Cytoplasmic translation  | Down      | Rpl18a, Rpl26, Rpl7a, Rps13, Rps27a, …      |

Reactome_Pathways_2024 (UP):  
| Theme                 | Direction | Leading Genes                                  |  
|-----------------------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------|  
| Oxidative Phosphorylation | Up   | Tomm22, Atp5pb, Ndufb4, Cox4i1, Ndufb6, …     |

Reactome_Pathways_2024 (DOWN):  
| Theme                                         | Direction | Leading Genes                       |  
|-----------------------------------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------|  
| Regulation of Expression of SLITs and ROBOs   | Down      | Psma3, Psmc3, Rpl18a, Rpl26, … Pabpc1|

MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 (UP):  
| Theme                  | Direction | Leading Genes                                 |  
|------------------------|-----------|------------------------------------------------|  
| Oxidative Phosphorylation | Up     | Tomm22, Atp5pb, Atp5me, Ndufb4, … Vdac2        |

MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 (DOWN):  
| Theme   | Direction | Leading Genes |  
|---------|-----------|---------------|  
| Myogenesis | Down  | Pvalb, Myh3, … |

Proteomics confirms downregulation of ribosomal proteins and cytosolic translation (overlap with polysome), with upregulation of mitochondrial energy metabolism and disease-linked pathways (Parkinson’s).

Targeted subset (keywords “ribosome,” “translation,” “tRNA”):  

From polysome GSEA, core translational terms (‘Ribosome’, ‘Cytoplasmic translation’, ‘SRP targeting’) are among the most downregulated (NES < –2.5; leading-edge genes largely Rps/Rpl family). In proteomics, the ribosome pathway is also the top downregulated KEGG term (NES –4.66). Conversely, tRNA aminoacylation is strongly up in polysome (NES 2.24) and appears as a high-NES Reactome term, suggesting selective translation of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases despite global translational suppression.

Key Genes/Proteins  
Up (compensatory/proliferative)  
| Gene     | Direction | Role/Function                       | Pathway(s)                          |  
|----------|-----------|-------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|  
| PLK1     | Up        | Mitotic kinase                      | Mitotic spindle, cell-cycle DNA replication |  
| RPL18A   | Up/Down*  | 60S ribosomal subunit, structural   | Cytoplasmic translation, SRP targeting       |  
| RPS27A   | Up/Down*  | 40S ribosomal protein, ubiquitin precursor | Ribosome, SRP targeting     |  
| LARS2    | Up        | Mitochondrial leucyl-tRNA synthetase| tRNA aminoacylation, amino acid activation |  

(*shared between downregulated translation modules and upregulated stress/repair modules)

Comparisons and Confidence  
- Polysome and proteomics both show downregulation of core translation (ribosomal proteins) with high confidence.  
- Mitochondrial organization/oxidative phosphorylation is upregulated at the protein level but less pronounced in polysome data, suggesting post-transcriptional regulation.  

Implications  
ELP1 haploinsufficiency disrupts global translation initiation/elongation while sparing or enhancing specific translational programs (aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases) and triggering proliferative and metabolic pathways. This uncoupling may underlie aberrant GNP proliferation in SHH-MB predisposition.

Next Steps & Clarification  
1. Validate selective upregulation of tRNA synthetases at the translational level by polysome qPCR and immunoblot.  
2. Test whether pharmacologic inhibition of PLK1 or aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases affects Elp1HET GNP proliferation.  
3. Examine ELP1’s role in ribosome assembly versus tRNA charging by in vitro reconstitution assays.  
4. Clarify whether PERK/GCN2 stress pathways (EIF2AK4 response) causally link translational suppression to SHH pathway activation.
